name: Sun
textureCredit: NASA/SDO and SOHO via Solar System Scope

description.en: The Sun is the star at the center of our solar system. Its gravity holds the solar system together, and its energy supports life on Earth.
description.id: Matahari adalah bintang di pusat tata surya kita. Gravitasinya menjaga tata surya tetap terikat, dan energinya mendukung kehidupan di Bumi.
